# List of international presidential trips made by Ranasinghe Premadasa

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Ranasinghe Premadasa, who served as the 3rd President of Sri Lanka 2 January 1989 to 1 May
1993.
Summary of international trips
Ranasinghe Premadasa made 2 foreign trips to 6 countries.
